rows.opponent-searches-top-four-then-shuffles: CR 701.23f: with Aven Mindcensor's replacement, the opponent's Veteran Explorer search may take cards only from the top four of their library, though the whole library is still shuffled afterwards. Observed: the opponent's search could take the 5th card, so the Plains went onto the battlefield (the Forest from the top four and the 2 shuffle damage from Psychogenic Probe were as expected).
